# Test images

All images are taken from the [scikit-image](https://scikit-image.org) test
data (`skimage/data`, version 0.26) and re-encoded. They are free of copyright
restrictions according to scikit-image's documentation:

| File | Original | Category | Source / licence (as stated by scikit-image) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `person-astronaut.jpg` | `astronaut.png` | person | Photograph of Eileen Collins by NASA; no known copyright restrictions, public domain |
| `animal-cat.jpg` | `chelsea.png` | animal, fur, whiskers | Stéfan van der Walt; CC0 |
| `product-coffee.png` | `coffee.png` | product | Rachel Michetti, courtesy of Pikolo Espresso Bar; CC0 |
| `thin-structures-rocket.webp` | `rocket.jpg` | thin structures (launch towers) | SpaceX; public domain |
| `motion-blur-clock.jpg` | `clock_motion.png` | motion blur, soft edges (greyscale) | Stéfan van der Walt; released into the public domain |
| `transparent-horse.png` | `horse.png` | input that already has transparency | Andreas Preuss; CC0 |

Please only add images you took yourself or that are clearly licensed for
redistribution (CC0 / public domain). Never add images copied from search
engines or stock sites.
